intro.title: Secrets & compliance
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple secrets management system to securely store and access sensitive data like API keys. You'll learn the core concept of secrets management, which involves protecting confidential information from exposure in your codebase. The main technologies involved include environment variables and basic configuration files to separate secrets from application logic. By the end, you'll understand how to implement compliance practices by keeping secrets out of version control and using secure storage methods.
intro.usecase: In production engineering, secrets management and compliance are critical for securing applications that handle sensitive data. Developers implement these patterns in admin dashboards to securely store API keys, database credentials, and encryption keys while maintaining audit trails. For example, payment processing systems use secrets management to protect merchant tokens and PCI-compliant data storage, while healthcare applications implement compliance controls for HIPAA-protected patient information. These patterns appear in configuration panels where engineers rotate credentials, monitor access logs, and enforce security policies across deployment environments.
